entry.title: Ebola · DR Congo: CDC: 10,990 confirmed cases and 5,354 deaths in DR Congo
entry.summary: CDC's situation summary, with data as of 8 November, counts 10,990 confirmed cases and 5,354 confirmed deaths in DR Congo. CDC's counts differ from the DR Congo national health institute's 30 October figures because the agencies use different reporting dates and methods. CDC calls it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

entry.title: Ebola · DR Congo: Kenya releases 46 contacts and discharges five patients
entry.summary: Kenya's health ministry said 46 contacts completed monitoring without symptoms and were released from quarantine on 3 November, bringing the total released to 66, and that 52 remain, expected out by 11 November. Five patients were discharged after testing negative and two remain under treatment. Kenya's count stays at nine confirmed cases, two of them fatal. The ministry said the outbreak would not be declared over until a 42-day countdown is complete.
entry.content:

The ministry said the outbreak would not be declared over until a 42-day countdown is complete.

Sources: Kenya News Agency, Washington Times (3 Nov), Xinhua (4 Nov)

entry.title: Ebola · DR Congo: DR Congo institute: 10,414 cases and 5,372 deaths as of 30 October
entry.summary: A situation report from a DR Congo national health institute counts 10,414 confirmed cases and 5,372 deaths as of 30 October, a case fatality rate of 51.6%. Bloomberg names the National Institute of Public Health and Africanews the National Institute of Biomedical Research. Bloomberg reported that the rate rose above 50% after health authorities "added hundreds of previously unallocated fatalities to the official toll"; Africanews described the increase in deaths as "a retrospective adjustment of data between the local data processing team and the Ituri Province outbreak management team", not a single-day surge. ECDC's latest count, from data up to 28 October, is 10,274 confirmed cases and 4,992 deaths.

entry.title: Ebola · DR Congo: Nigeria identifies two suspected cases in the north-east
entry.summary: Nigeria's centre for disease control (NCDC) said on 31 October that it has identified two suspected Ebola cases in the north-east of the country. The two people are in isolation while laboratory tests and contact tracing begin. NCDC said that being classed as suspected does not mean a case is confirmed, and that confirmation depends on laboratory results. Nigeria's one confirmed case remains the imported case reported on 20 October.

entry.title: Cholera · Global: Zambia: 1,622 cholera cases and 30 deaths
entry.summary: Zambia's health minister told Parliament on 29 October that the new outbreak has reached 1,622 cases, 228 of them laboratory-confirmed, and 30 deaths between 28 July and 28 October, in 20 districts across six provinces, according to Diggers and Mwebantu. That is up from the 966 cases and 25 deaths the health ministry reported on 17 October. Lusaka province has the most cases, at 1,090.

entry.title: Mpox · Africa & world: Southern Nevada reports its first clade I mpox case
entry.summary: The Southern Nevada Health District reported the first confirmed clade I mpox case in a Clark County resident. The district said the person has no reported travel exposure, so the source of infection is unclear, and that it has reported 11 clade II cases since August. It said anyone who may have been exposed should contact a health care provider and watch for symptoms for 21 days, and that JYNNEOS vaccine is expected to protect against both clades.
